name: 星猫 · 吃掉应用演示
author: Lyra Code
html:
<style>
:root{--fur:#70A4FF;--speed:1.5s}body{display:grid;place-items:center}svg{width:96%;height:96%;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px #0004);animation:breathe var(--speed) ease-in-out infinite}.fur{fill:var(--fur)}#mouth{transition:d .2s}#badge{fill:#a6e5c0}body[data-state=thinking] svg{animation:think var(--speed) ease-in-out infinite}body[data-state=executing] svg{animation:hop .4s infinite alternate}body[data-state=approval] #badge{fill:#ffd580}body[data-state=error] #badge{fill:#ffb4ab}body[data-docked=true] #eyes{transform:scaleY(.35);transform-origin:50% 50%}.tap{animation:hop .2s 3!important}.eat{animation:eat .8s!important}@keyframes breathe{50%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}@keyframes think{50%{transform:rotate(8deg)}}@keyframes hop{to{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.06,.94)}}@keyframes eat{50%{transform:scale(1.3) rotate(-12deg)}}
</style><svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"><path class="fur" d="M15 43 12 9 37 26Q50 20 64 26L88 9 85 44Q100 85 50 91 0 85 15 43"/><path fill="#ffd1df" d="m18 21 4 20 10-12zm64 0-14 8 10 12z"/><g id="eyes" fill="#16253d"><ellipse cx="34" cy="53" rx="5" ry="7"/><ellipse cx="66" cy="53" rx="5" ry="7"/></g><path id="mouth" d="m43 67 7 6 7-6" stroke="#16253d" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle id="badge" cx="80" cy="80" r="10" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"/></svg><script>
let config={roam:false,speed:1.5}, petState='idle';
addEventListener('lyrapet',({detail:{type,data}})=>{
 if(type==='config'){config=data;document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--fur',data.color);document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--speed',data.speed+'s')}
 if(type==='state'){petState=data.state;document.body.dataset.state=data.state;document.body.dataset.docked=data.docked}
 if(type==='tap'||type==='drag'){document.querySelector('svg').classList.add('tap');setTimeout(()=>document.querySelector('svg').classList.remove('tap'),600)}
 if(type==='operationResult'&&data.operation==='uninstall'&&data.ok){document.querySelector('svg').classList.add('eat');setTimeout(()=>document.querySelector('svg').classList.remove('eat'),900)}
});
setInterval(()=>{if(config.roam&&petState==='idle'){if(document.body.dataset.docked==='true')lyraPet.emit('reveal');else lyraPet.emit('move',{dx:Math.round(Math.random()*12-6),dy:Math.round(Math.random()*8-4)})}},1200);
</script><script>
let currentPackage='', eatEnabled=false;
addEventListener('lyrapet',({detail:{type,data}})=>{
 if(type==='config')eatEnabled=!!data.eatMode;
 if(type==='state')currentPackage=data.packageName;
 if(type==='tap'&&eatEnabled&&currentPackage)lyraPet.emit('requestUninstall',{packageName:currentPackage});
});
</script>
